[[ES Hammam-Sousse|ESHS]] 1–4 [[Club Africain|CA]] | highest scoring = [[EGS Gafsa|EGSG]] 4–4 [[Club Africain|CA]] | matches = 182 | total goals = 405 | prevseason = [[2009–10 Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1|2009–10]] | nextseason = [[2011–12 Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1|2011–12]] }} The '''2010–11 [[Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1]]'''(''Tunisian Professional League'') season was the 56th season of top-tier [[football in Tunisia]]. The competition began on 24 July 2010, and will conclude on 8 May 2011. The defending champions from the [[2009–10 Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1|previous season]] are [[Espérance Sportive de Tunis]]. No teams were relegated as [[Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1|Ligue 1]] was to be extended to 16 teams starting from the [[2011–12 Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1|2011–12 season]]. ==Team movements==
